title: Geologic map of the Coastal Plain in Johnston and Edgefield quadrangles, Edgefield and Saluda Counties, South Carolina
citation: Willoughby, R.H., 1985, Geologic map of the Coastal Plain in Johnston and Edgefield quadrangles, Edgefield and Saluda Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-46, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Coastal Plain of Johnston and Edgefield quadrangles OFR-46 (Willoughby 1985; digital 2010). 24 SCGS drill-hole labels read on the map face (logs not printed); text also names 19-41 and 19-47 (not located on the face). Text localities (1)-(12) recorded with printed coordinates and ground elevations; datum not stated. Locality (11) longitude printed 82 degrees, read as 81. SUBSURFACE: section A-A' (VE 25) interpretive; outcrop elevations are ground elevations, not contacts.
